ex.en: Where is the United Airlines check-in counter?
ex.zh: 聯合航空的報到櫃檯在哪裡？

ex.en: Where is the information counter?
ex.zh: 詢問處在哪裡？

ex.en: Please pay at this counter.
ex.zh: 請在這個櫃檯付款。

ex.en: Matthew's dog, Rocky, loves to steal cupcakes off the kitchen counter.
ex.zh: 馬修的狗洛基喜歡從廚房檯面上偷紙杯蛋糕。

ex.en: Please don't leave dirty dishes on the counter.
ex.zh: 請不要把髒碗盤放在檯面上。

ex.en: When the counter value reaches the assigned 'lucky-number' it displays a congratulatory message.
ex.zh: 當計數器的數值達到預設的「幸運號碼」時，就會顯示一則恭喜訊息。

ex.en: The website has a visitor counter at the bottom of the page.
ex.zh: 這個網站的頁面底部有一個訪客計數器。

ex.en: I almost missed my connecting flight in Hong Kong.
ex.zh: 我差點在香港錯過轉機航班。

ex.en: If your first flight is late, the airline will rebook your connecting flight.
ex.zh: 如果你的第一段航班延誤，航空公司會幫你改訂轉機航班。

ex.en: The airline offered us compensation for the long delay.
ex.zh: 航空公司因為長時間延誤而提供我們賠償。

ex.en: You may be entitled to compensation if your flight is canceled.
ex.zh: 如果航班被取消，你可能有權獲得賠償。

ex.en: The job offers good compensation and benefits.
ex.zh: 這份工作提供不錯的薪酬和福利。

ex.en: Compensation includes a base salary and an annual bonus.
ex.zh: 薪酬包括底薪和年終獎金。

ex.en: The concierge recommended a great restaurant nearby.
ex.zh: 禮賓人員推薦了附近一家很棒的餐廳。

ex.en: Ask the concierge to book a taxi for you.
ex.zh: 請禮賓人員幫你叫計程車。

ex.en: The hotel offers complimentary breakfast.
ex.zh: 這家飯店提供免費早餐。

ex.en: Guests receive a complimentary bottle of water.
ex.zh: 房客會獲贈一瓶免費的水。

ex.en: She made some complimentary remarks about my work.
ex.zh: 她對我的工作說了些讚美的話。

ex.en: The reviews were mostly complimentary.
ex.zh: 評論大多是讚美。

ex.en: The train was packed with commuters.
ex.zh: 火車上擠滿了通勤族。

ex.en: Many commuters read on their phones on the way to work.
ex.zh: 許多通勤族在上班途中用手機閱讀。

ex.en: Traffic congestion is a big problem in the city center.
ex.zh: 交通壅塞是市中心的大問題。

ex.en: Taking the MRT helps reduce congestion.
ex.zh: 搭捷運有助於減少交通壅塞。

ex.en: This medicine relieves nasal congestion.
ex.zh: 這種藥可以緩解鼻塞。

ex.en: I have a bad cold with a lot of congestion.
ex.zh: 我得了重感冒，鼻塞很嚴重。

ex.en: I have only 40 minutes to make my connection.
ex.zh: 我只有 40 分鐘趕下一班轉乘。

ex.en: We missed our connection in Frankfurt.
ex.zh: 我們在法蘭克福錯過了轉機。

ex.en: My internet connection was cut off.
ex.zh: 我的網路連線被切斷了。

ex.en: Why is my Internet connection so slow?
ex.zh: 我的網路怎麼這麼慢？

ex.en: There is no connection between them.
ex.zh: 兩者沒有關聯。

ex.en: A connection between personality and blood type has not been scientifically proven.
ex.zh: 科學上還沒有證實血型和性格有關聯。

ex.en: Tom is standing in the corner of the room.
ex.zh: 湯姆正站在房間的角落。

ex.en: Who is the man sitting in the corner?
ex.zh: 坐在角落的那個男人是誰？

ex.en: When you are driving, you should slow down on corners.
ex.zh: 開車時，轉彎處要減速。

ex.en: There's a convenience store on the corner.
ex.zh: 轉角有一家便利商店。

ex.en: The teacher confiscated a student's phone because he was texting in class.
ex.zh: 老師沒收了一個學生的手機，因為他上課傳簡訊。

ex.en: The package was confiscated by customs.
ex.zh: 包裹被海關沒收了。

ex.en: Customs officers found contraband in his suitcase.
ex.zh: 海關人員在他的行李箱裡發現違禁品。

ex.en: Smuggling contraband can lead to a long prison sentence.
ex.zh: 走私違禁品可能會被判重刑。

ex.en: He got a concussion after falling off his bike.
ex.zh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來後腦震盪。

ex.en: Players with a concussion should not return to the game.
ex.zh: 腦震盪的球員不應該回到比賽中。
